raw_text: I spent an hour looking for that small café we went to during our Goa trip last year. I know we were sitting outside on blue chairs, but I can't remember the café name or exact date. I searched 'Goa café' and 'Goa restaurant' in Google Photos, but it only showed generic beach photos and landmark pictures. Why can't it find photos based on the setting?

Search is terrible when you don't know the exact date. I needed to find a photo of a prescription medicine bottle I took last year when I was sick. I typed 'medicine bottle' and 'sick' but zero results came up. I had to manually scroll through 8,000 photos from 2025 to find it. Please add better visual search filters!

My friend's birthday was a couple of years ago and we were sitting outside on a patio. I searched 'birthday' and 'sitting outside', but Photos only brings up tagged faces. My friend isn't tagged so search returned nothing. Is there a way to search by event context instead of tagged names?

I booked a train ticket months ago and took a screenshot. Now I need the PNR/seat number, but I can't find the screenshot. I searched 'train ticket' and 'IRCTC', but Lens didn't index the text properly because it was dark mode. Gave up searching and searched my email instead.

raw_text: Great app for backup, but search sucks for old receipts. I have over 15,000 photos. When I type 'receipt' it gives me 500 images in a huge grid with no way to filter by month or total amount. Result evaluation is impossible without opening every single thumb.

I was looking for a photo of my sister and me at a concert in 2024. I typed 'concert with my sister' but Google Photos doesn't understand relationship words like 'sister' unless you manually create a person tag. Had to open Apple Photos which actually groups by shared trip.
